column1: POL-101,Global Paid Time Off (PTO) and Vacation Policy,Human Resources,2024-01-01,Human Resources,"Outlines annual PTO accruals, carry-over limits, rollover rules, and approval procedures for employees worldwide.","All full-time employees accrue Paid Time Off (PTO) at a rate of 1.66 days per month, yielding up to 20 business days per calendar year. Employees are required to submit leave requests through Workday at least 5 business days in advance for planned absences exceeding 3 consecutive days. A maximum of 5 unused PTO days may be carried over into the following calendar year; any additional unused balance beyond 5 days is forfeited on December 31st unless local labor laws mandate payout. PTO requests during peak business quarters require written approval from the department VP."

POL-102,Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) & Hardware Security,Information Security,2023-09-15,Information Security,"Security standards and MDM enrollment mandatory for personal devices accessing corporate data.","Employees accessing company systems, emails, or databases on personal mobile devices or laptops must enroll their device in the corporate Mobile Device Management (MDM) platform (Okta Verify / Kandji). Personal devices must maintain active disk encryption (FileVault or BitLocker), auto-lock after 5 minutes of inactivity, and run an approved Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agent. Storing unencrypted sensitive company data, customer PII, or source code on personal local storage is strictly prohibited and constitutes a major security violation."

POL-103,Corporate Travel and Expense Reimbursement Policy,Finance,2024-03-01,Finance,"Reimbursement rules, per diem limits, lodging caps, and expense reporting workflows via Concur.","All business-related expenses must be submitted via SAP Concur within 30 days of incurring the expense along with itemized receipts. Daily per diem caps for meals during corporate travel are set to $75 USD for domestic trips and $110 USD for international trips. Flights under 6 hours must be booked in Economy / Main Cabin; Business Class is only permissible for non-stop flights exceeding 8 hours with VP approval. Expenses exceeding $500 USD require prior manager pre-authorization in writing before booking."

POL-104,Remote and Flexible Work Policy,Human Resources,2023-11-01,Human Resources,"Hybrid work schedules, core collaboration hours, home office stipend, and geographic eligibility.","Employees in eligible roles may work remotely up to 3 days per week upon manager approval, with mandatory in-office presence on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Remote workers must remain available on Slack and Zoom during core business hours (10:00 AM to 4:00 PM local time zone). Full-time remote employees qualify for a one-time $500 USD home office equipment stipend, subject to expense submission within 60 days of hire. Relocating to a different state or country requires HR and tax team approval prior to moving."

POL-105,"Access Control, Password & Authentication Policy",Information Security,2024-02-01,Information Security,"Authentication requirements, multi-factor authentication (MFA), password complexity, and session timeouts.","All corporate accounts must enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) using hardware security keys or authenticator apps; SMS-based MFA is strictly prohibited. Master passwords must be a minimum of 16 characters in length and updated every 180 days. Accounts are automatically locked out after 5 consecutive failed login attempts. Shared credentials or credential reuse across personal and work accounts is explicitly forbidden. Privileged access (prod root, admin consoles) requires Just-In-Time (JIT) elevation and approval ticket reference."

POL-106,Software Asset Management & Procurement Policy,IT Operations,2023-08-20,IT Support,"Guidelines for software acquisition, license provisioning, shadow IT prevention, and vendor reviews.","Employees may only install software listed in the official Enterprise Software Catalog. Requesting unapproved third-party software, SaaS applications, or browser extensions requires submission of an IT Security Risk Assessment ticket. Expense reports for unauthorized software subscriptions bought via personal credit cards will be rejected by Finance. IT reserves the right to automatically revoke unused software licenses after 45 days of inactivity."

POL-107,"Data Protection, Privacy and GDPR Compliance",Legal & Compliance,2024-01-15,Legal,"Handling regulations for Personally Identifiable Information (PII), customer data retention, and privacy rights.","All customer and employee PII must be encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3). Employees handling European Union or California resident data must adhere strictly to GDPR and CCPA compliance guidelines, including honoring Data Subject Access Requests (DSAR) within 30 days. PII data must never be dumped into non-production database environments or exposed to unvetted LLM tools. Any suspected data leak must be reported to security@company.com within 1 hour of discovery."

POL-108,Acceptable Use of Generative AI & LLM Tools,Information Security,2024-04-01,Information Security,"Approved generative AI utilities, data submission restrictions, and intellectual property guidelines.","Employees may only use company-sanctioned enterprise AI instances (e.g., Enterprise ChatGPT, internal RAG search tools) that guarantee data opt-outs from public training sets. Inputting proprietary source code, internal financial results, customer data, or confidential HR records into public/free AI models is strictly forbidden. AI-generated code or text must be thoroughly code-reviewed and human-verified prior to merging into production environments."

POL-109,Code of Conduct & Anti-Harassment Policy,Human Resources,2023-05-10,Human Resources,"Workplace behavior standards, anti-discrimination guidelines, reporting mechanisms, and non-retaliation.","The company maintains a zero-tolerance policy for harassment, discrimination, or bullying based on race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, or disability. All employees are expected to maintain professional conduct across all communication channels, including Slack, email, and virtual meetings. Incidents can be reported confidentially to HR or via the anonymous Ethics Hotline. Retaliation against anyone reporting a grievance in good faith is strictly prohibited and subject to immediate termination."

POL-110,Incident Response & Security Breach Notification,Information Security,2024-05-01,Information Security,"Protocols for reporting, isolating, and resolving cybersecurity incidents and data exposure.","In the event of a security incident, ransomware attack, or unauthorized access, the discovering employee must immediately file an Urgent (P1) ticket via ServiceNow or ping the #security-incidents Slack channel. The Incident Response Team (IRT) will assume total control over affected systems, with the authority to revoke network access or isolate cloud clusters without prior notice. Public disclosure or external statements regarding security breaches are exclusively restricted to the Legal and Communications leadership team."
